method.execution: V8 pure in-memory data computation; no shell, Git process, SDK, filesystem or Runtime execution
method.hash_functions: SHA-1 for ordinary Git object headers plus bytes; SHA-256 for the two complete output byte strings. The saved function accepts those byte-string hash functions as arguments.
method.canonical_verification: Rebuilt every directory Git tree from its exact mode, UTF-8 basename and raw 20-byte object ID, using Git directory slash ordering; 357 subtree digests and the root digest matched.
method.output_order: Recursive Git tree traversal; separately byte-sorted complete UTF-8 paths for the index. Those two path sequences are exactly equal for these 3914 leaves.
method.encoding: Raw UTF-8 paths, literal TAB and NUL delimiters, final NUL, no additional newline, no quoting or JSON serialization of the generated stream.
method.index_stage: The reconstruction uses stage 0 for each canonical leaf. This is not assumed for arbitrary indexes: the resulting entire byte string matches this run's core.commands measured stdout size and SHA-256.
method.persistence: Both generated byte strings were uploaded as base64 Git blobs, then the complete stored content was fetched and verified against byte count, SHA-256 and Git blob ID.
